title: What is React?
content: React is a JavaScript library used to build user interfaces.

title: What is TypeScript?
content: TypeScript is a programming language that adds static typing to JavaScript.

title: What is Tailwind CSS?
content: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework for styling web applications.

title: What is an API?
content: An API allows different software applications to communicate with each other.

title: What is JSON?
content: JSON is a lightweight data format used to store and exchange information.
